LESSON: LETTER FORMATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.6: Letter formation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Letter formation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Experience pleasure participating in letter formation activities in and out of class. colour and paint letters of the alphabet while singing related rhymes. trace, shade letter outlines or join dots to form letters. letter formation games. 38 themselves as they practise how to hold the pen and form letters and view the clips as they receive positive feedback.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Experience pleasure participating in letter formation activities in and out of class. colour and paint letters of the alphabet while singing related rhymes. trace, shade letter outlines or join dots to form letters. letter formation games. 38 themselves as they practise how to hold the pen and form letters and view the clips as they receive positive feedback.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to experience pleasure participating in letter formation activities in and out of class. colour and paint letters of the alphabet while singing related rhymes. trace, shade letter outlines or join dots to form letters. letter formation games. 38 themselves as they practise how to hold the pen and form letters and view the clips as they receive positive feedback. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Letter formation.
2. Explain Letter formation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Letter formation.
4. Show that you can: Experience pleasure participating in letter formation activities in and out of class. colour and paint letters of the alphabet while singing related rhymes. trace, shade letter outlines or join dots to form letters. letter formation games. 38 themselves as they practise how to hold the pen and form letters and view the clips as they receive positive feedback.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Letter formation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Letter formation important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Experience pleasure participating in letter formation activities in and out of class. colour and paint letters of the alphabet while singing related rhymes. trace, shade letter outlines or join dots to form letters. letter formation games. 38 themselves as they practise how to hold the pen and form letters and view the clips as they receive positive feedback.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
